description: Vote on a scan, as the Mark as Safe and Mark as Malicious buttons on its result page do: report_type 'positive_feedback' marks the scanned page as safe and 'malware' marks it as malicious. report_details is an optional note of up to 1000 characters. Votes are recorded as crowd feedback on the scan and are rate-limited per client IP. The website's other report types (phishing, spam, copyright and so on) need a captcha and are not available here.
name: submit_scan_report
title: Submit Scan Report
